Maya (SE): kicking off a POC for NimbusRetail — they want streaming + function calls + structured JSON output. need a short runbook and answers on auth/pricing/lead times
Sam K (Presales): awesome — rough q: qps and expected concurrent streams? also will they demo tool-calls to backend inventory service?
Maya (SE): target 50 concurrent streams, peak 120 qps, typical prompt lengths ~150 tokens. yes they'll call inventory.update and return a compact JSON schema per item.
Ben R (AE): pricing ballpark for POC: hosted per-token during POC + option to reserve a small Dedicated slice if they want stability. estimate: ~10M tokens over 2 weeks -> I'll run numbers; reserved capacity lead time depends on region.
Leah P (Security): firewall/SSO notes: Nimbus requires SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, and SOC2 attestation. confirm data residency (EU) please.
Maya (SE): they want EU-only. can we do Private or Dedicated in eu-west?
deploy-bot: Dedicated capacity availability: eu-west-1 has limited capacity for reserve requests — typical lead time 7-14 days for guaranteed pool. ephemeral bursts available sooner.
Sam K (Presales): for POC we can do hosted with IP allowlist + customer-managed KMS + VPC peering to meet EU residency for inference, but audit log retention in our control plane may be US by default unless EU logging add-on enabled. Leah, can you confirm tradeoffs?
Leah P (Security): confirm: hosted + customer KMS + VPC peering meets EU data-in-transit/residency for inference. audit logs: need EU logging add-on (legal/procurement review). also DPA + SCCs required. if they want all control plane logs in EU we recommend Dedicated or Private.
procurement-bot: DPA + SCCs + SOC2: https://redwood.internal/docs/legal/dpa_and_sccs.pdf ; EU logging add-on: https://redwood.internal/pricing/eu-logging
Maya (SE): technical Q: need a small Go example for streaming toolcall + structured JSON response to show in demo. can someone paste a snippet?
Sam K (Presales): quick snippet (very small) to drop into demo app — sanitize before sharing:
Sam K (Presales): ```go
// simplified streaming + toolcall pseudo-example
client := redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
stream := client.Stream(ctx, redwood.StreamRequest{
  Model: "gpt-stream-1",
  Prompt: "Update inventory for order #1234",
  Tools: []redwood.Tool{{Name: "inventory.update", Schema: `{"id":"string","qty":"int"}`}},
})
for msg := range stream.Messages() {
  switch msg.Type {
  case redwood.MsgFunctionCall:
    call := msg.FunctionCall
    // call their inventory service (HTTP/gRPC)
    resp := callExternalInventory(call.Payload)
    // respond back to the model with the function result
    stream.SendFunctionResponse(call.Name, resp)
  case redwood.MsgOutput:
    fmt.Println("Model output:", string(msg.Data)) // structured JSON
  }
}
```
Ben R (AE): looks good. I'll draft a one-pager with three pricing paths: hosted POC, 30d reserved trial, and small Dedicated commit. will share numbers EOD tomorrow.
Maya (SE): security questionnaire incoming from Nimbus infosec. who handles vendor questionnaires?
Leah P (Security): send it to me + procurement. I'll fill SOC2/KMS/VPC answers. if they request penetration test artifacts we have a consolidated redacted report.
Maya (SE): blockers list: 1) EU residency confirmation 2) sanitized sample dataset for demo 3) SAML test account for SSO handshake 4) pricing approval for demo credits
Sam K (Presales): action items: - Ben to provide provisional pricing by EOD tomorrow - Leah to confirm EU logging and DPA caveats - Maya to get sanitized sample and SAML test account by Tue - I'll assemble a 30-min demo script with the Go snippet :thumbsup:
Ben R (AE): on it, sending draft pricing in-thread when ready.
Leah P (Security): will attach DPA caveats and EU logging checklist by EOD.

Ben R (AE): Wed 10:00 UTC works for me.

Sam K (Presales): recommend gpt-stream-1 with dynamic batching disabled for demo. if latency is still high, switch to a smaller low-latency variant and enable prefix KV caching. run a canary to measure and adjust.
Maya (SE): perfect. summary queued — I'll post calendar invite and follow up with sanitized data. :white_check_mark:
